lookbackDuration.description:
A lookback duration for the current reconstruction algorithm that helps determine the time interval in which data
should be fetched.

reconstructionSuffix.description: An optional suffix that is added to the column names of the reconstruction {@link Data}.

residualSuffix.description: An optional suffix that is added to the column names of the residual {@link Data}.

vertices.description: List of all vertices in this graph.

edges.description: List of all edges in this graph.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

scoreNames.description: Names of the {@link #score} outputs for this machine learning pipeline.

trainRun.description:
Single workflow run triggered by training of this {@link MlPipeline}.

NOTE: due to the immutability of pipelines, each training produces a new instance, which means that each pipeline
instance can only be associated with a single training run.
Also, keep in mind that a {@link WorkflowExecutorRun} might be periodically cleaned up, so this reference might
not be always resolvable.

trainStatus.description:
Status of {@link #trainRun}. Holds important meta information (e.g. `startedby`) that needs to be persisted with this pipeline,
even if the {@link #trainRun} reference is eventually cleaned up.

doNotAutoUpsert.description:
Controls the behavior of {@link MlPipeline#beforeMake}
If set, all the {@link MlPipe}s referenced by this {@link MlPipeline} are not upserted.

targets.description:
A list of all target names in the `features` {@link Data} to build an estimator for. This must be specified
even if all features will have estimators.

targetToFeatures.description:
By default, all other features will be used to train the regressors for each target. To select which features to
use to train a particular target's regressor, populate this map of target names to the list of feature names to
use. If a particular target name is not included in this map, all other features will be used.

includeTarget.description: If set, include the {@link targets} as an output of this pipeline.

targetSuffix.description: If {@link #includeTarget} is set, this suffix will be added to each target column.

regressor.description:
The regression model to train for each target. If only this field is populated, this regressor will be used on
all targets.

At least this field or {@link #targetToRegressor} must be populated.

targetToRegressor.description:
A map of target name to the model that should be trained to regress the target. If both {@link #regressor} and
this field are populated, this map will act as an override. If {@link #regressor} is not populated, this field
should contain an entry for each target.

scoringMetric.description:
The scoring metric that should be used to score the performance of a target's {@link #regressor}. If only this
field is populated, this scoring metric will be used on all targets.

At least this field or {@link #targetToScoringMetric} must be populated to perform HPO on this pipeline.

scoreAggregation.description:
An aggregation function to aggregate all the scores into a single score using the
{@link Reconstruction.ScoreAggregationPipe}. If the field is not set or there is only a single score, then no
aggregation will take place.

targetToInterpreter.description:
A map of target name to the interpreter that will interpret the target's {@link #regressor}. If both
{@link #interpreter} and this field are populated, this map will act as an override.

title:
This type represents a Virtual Sensing {@link MlTemplate.Pipeline} which employs a regressor to model each target
phenomena using existing measurements (features). This template can be configured to build and train a regression-
based reconstruction pipeline on 2D timeseries feature data and can have as many regressors as columns in the data.
Users can also specify scoring metrics, either the same or different metric for each target, to perform HPO on this
pipeline and can specify interpreters to learn about each regressor's behavior.

By default, this pipeline will return `reconstructions` and `residuals` as output but can also be configured to
return a {@link Data} of the `targets` by setting {@link #includeTarget}.
name: Reconstruction.Algorithm.VirtualSensingPipeline
